panels.description: Words your visitors may not know, explained where they appear in your pages. Headings, links, buttons, the menu and the footer are left alone. Changes show on your pages right away.

store.tagline: Explain jargon where it appears: dotted underlines that show a definition.
store.longDescription:
Glossary explains the words your visitors might not know, right where they read them. List your terms once, each with a short explanation, and they get a dotted underline in your pages. Pointing at one, tapping it or tabbing to it shows the explanation in a small bubble.

It only touches running text. Headings, links, buttons, code, the menu, header and footer are left exactly as they are, and so is anything inside a tag. By default only the first mention of each term on a page is marked, so a page does not turn into a sea of underlines; you can mark every mention if you prefer.

Terms can have other spellings, like "SEO | search engine optimisation", and the longest match wins. The bubbles work with a mouse, a finger and the keyboard, close with Escape, and flip below the word when there is no room above.

The plugin asks for one permission, storage, to keep your terms.

screenshots.caption: A menu that explains itself: tap or point at sourdough to see what it means.
The settings: one term per line, then choose how often to mark it and the colour.
